newsitem.title: USA: Cameron Ashley sees "modest growth" in 97.
newsitem.headline: Cameron Ashley sees "modest growth" in 97.

text.p: Cameron Ashley Building Products Inc said Tuesday it expects modest growth in market conditions in 1997 and sees improving fixed cost absorption as the company completes its North American network.
In a release Tuesday the company said it was "looking forward to further executing (its) growth strategy in 1997" as it expected market conditions to "be marked by modest growth."
Cameron Ashley said that with its intention to acquire Boyd Distributors, a Canadian distributor of building products, the company is "positioned to complete the first phase of (its) strategy."
It said it expects the establishment of its North American distribution network, consisting of 160 branches with more than $1 billion in sales, to be completed by the end of fiscal 1998.
The company Tuesday reported net income for the fourth quarter of $4.2 million, or $0.46 per share, compared with net income of $2.5 million, or $0.27 per share, in the fourth quarter of 1995.

Earnings in the fourth quarter of 1996 were impacted by a non-recurring restructuring charge of $0.04 per share due to the consolidation of the company's Spokane operations into a single 120,000 square foot facility, the company said.
